escalations.question: MASTER-030: should net10.0-maccatalyst be implemented fully, dropped, or parked explicitly?
escalations.answer: Park it explicitly. Keep the TFM, and write an ADR recording that macCatalyst is build-verified but not run-verified, naming UI-021's five TODO(macOS) paths as a known accepted gap. Chosen because XCUT-004 states the ambiguity is the defect more than either resolution would be, and because nothing on this machine can run a macCatalyst build, so 'implement it fully' could produce no observed evidence for the five input paths.

options.summary: Park it explicitly with an ADR
options.rationale: Closes XCUT-004's stated defect (the ambiguity) at the lowest cost, and is the only option whose acceptance criteria are all reachable on this machine.
Closes UI-021, UI-036 and XCUT-004 outright and deletes a fraction of 5b/5c's work, but contradicts two repo design docs and is hardest to reverse.
Honours what the design docs commit to, but every criterion would rest on compilation and source inspection rather than observation.

escalations.question: MASTER-026: extract a net10.0 library, multi-target the Tests project, or both?
escalations.answer: Both. Extract map geometry and the control kit's presentation contracts into a net10.0 DungeonMaster.App.Core that DungeonMaster.Tests already reaches, closing MASTER-082 and MASTER-087 in the same move; and add a separate test project referencing DungeonMaster.App, run on Windows only. Chosen because the extraction library alone reaches nothing MAUI-typed, leaving Session 6's rescheduled entries (MASTER-006, 013, 055, 062) and MASTER-159 with no evidence path. At Gate 2 the user additionally approved a deviation from the literal 'multi-targeted' wording: DungeonMaster.App.Tests is single-targeted to net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0, because adding net10.0-maccatalyst produces NU1201 and pinning the platform version produces an empty ResolveFrameworkReference.RuntimePackPath - there is no macCatalyst test runtime pack on this machine.

options.summary: Both: net10.0 library plus a Windows-only MAUI-referencing test project
options.rationale: The only option that gives Session 6's rescheduled entries and MASTER-159 an evidence path, while also closing MASTER-082 and MASTER-087.
The audit's preferred shape; cheap and covers UI-017's geometry, but leaves every MAUI-typed defect assertable-only.
Reaches everything including XAML, but costs a second test host and leaves Common/Map in Application needing a separate answer.

escalations.question: T1's mandated ProjectReference additions rewrote src/DungeonMaster.App/packages.lock.json and src/DungeonMaster.Tests/packages.lock.json, which no task in the frozen manifest owns. How should the commit handle them?
escalations.answer: Amend T1's owns globs in the frozen manifest to include both lock files, then commit-task stages them normally. Chosen because both reviewers independently found the glob was drawn one level too narrow and that T1 did nothing wrong: Directory.Build.props:21 sets RestorePackagesWithLockFile=true, so criterion 6's mandated ProjectReference additions and criterion 12's committed lock files cannot both be satisfied while those files stay untouched. Diffs verified as +14 and +7 lines with zero deletions, containing only dungeonmaster.app.core project nodes.

options.summary: Amend T1's owns, then commit normally
options.rationale: Makes the manifest match what actually happened; both reviewers said the glob was too narrow.

options.summary: Stage them with T1's commit, leave the manifest alone
options.rationale: Preserves the freeze literally, but leaves the manifest asserting an ownership set the commit contradicts.

options.summary: Commit them separately after the merge
options.rationale: Keeps freeze and task commit literally clean, at the cost of intermediate commits that do not restore.
